stock.description: Ourgame International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in the creation and management of online card and board games, catering to both the Chinese and global markets. The company operates through two main divisions: the Lianzhong Group and the AESE Group. It maintains a comprehensive online gaming ecosystem, offering PC-based titles via its dedicated client portals, such as Ourgame Hall. For mobile users, it distributes games across Android and iOS platforms, primarily utilizing third-party channels, including mobile network operators. Additionally, web-based games are available through its proprietary websites, ourgame.com and worldpokertour.com, as well as through various third-party distribution partners. Beyond game delivery, Ourgame provides game hosting, continuous updates, and technical support for its internally developed and licensed titles, alongside implementing measures to prevent, detect, and resolve in-game cheating and hacking. The company also extends its services to include computer-related technical support, television production, brand licensing, tour event management, and consulting. Furthermore, it organizes and broadcasts online-to-offline mind-sports competitions, tournaments, television programs, and associated content. Founded in 1998, Ourgame International Holdings Limited is based in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.
